Reviewer: m3 pool job claude-team2 (the environment states no job kind or number), Claude Fable 5.2, mkinney / seat claude-team2; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Needs changes before merge.** This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code. This is the first review of this PR. It lists each finding that I have.

## What is good

- The output without a `COMP` record does not change. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or catalog file is in the diff.
- The words agree with the owner's statements on #4076: `G41` / `G42 Hnnn` on its own line after the C word, H from the pass number, `C001` with `H001`, `G40` in the block of the lead-out `G01`, no `G29`.
- The law is in a shared prelude helper (`crates/post/src/post/wire_offset.rs`), as the owner asked. The dialect words stay in the post.
- The new tests are in the directory suite `script_sodick_ln2w`. The Gate map names the post crate. The module has its provenance comment. The decision record is in `docs/decisions/4076-ln2w-wire-offset.md`.
- The Mark 21 post is not in the diff.

## Results, merged with `upstream/main` f0bdc5109 (built locally on m3, no runner)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `upstream/main` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate test offset --crate camcraft-post --binary script_sodick_ln2w` | 6 tests, 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 212 steps, 0 failed. This includes `script_sodick_ln2w`, `script_sodick_wire`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` and `wire_post` |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 5 test steps green. The step `light build (release --no-run)` is red, see below |
| Heavy lanes | not run. They are not a merge condition. No collaborator record names this head. The author's own run is in the PR body |

The red light step is not caused by this PR:

```
error[E0063]: missing field `entry` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`
  --> crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs:74:5
error: could not compile `camcraft-app` (test "start_exit_shared") due to 1 previous error
```

`crates/app` in the trial merge is identical to `upstream/main` (`git diff --quiet upstream/main HEAD -- crates/app`). The PR changes no file in that crate. The failure is from main (see #4155).

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

Goldens moved: none. `git diff --stat upstream/main...d2e1519ba -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog` is empty.

## Mutations that I ran again

| Mutation | Pin | Mutated | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wire_offset.rs`: `if (len + 1e-6 < need)` changed to `if (false)` | `offset::a_lead_in_shorter_than_the_wire_radius_is_refused_by_name` | red | green |
| `sodick-ln2w.cps`: `G40` removed from the lead-out block | `offset::a_control_side_wire_offset_posts_in_the_owners_form` | red | green |
| `sodick-ln2w.cps`: H fixed at `H001` | `offset::a_control_side_wire_offset_posts_in_the_owners_form` | red | green |

I also ran a temporary probe test with more streams. The findings 1 and 2 show its output. The probe is not in the tree.

## Requested before merge

1. **The law does not judge the lead-out move. A `G40` on a move of zero length posts with no refusal.** Class: the cancel move gets fewer checks than the engage move.
   - `crates/post/src/post/wire_offset.rs:78-86` checks only that the cancel move is straight. `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:513` then writes `G40 G01`.
   - Probe stream: `COMP right 0.165`, feed to (-25, 10), feed to (-25, -10), `COMP off`, feed to (-25, -10). Result, with no warning:
     ```
     G42 H001
     G01 X-25. Y10.
     G01 X-25. Y-10.
     G40 G01 X-25. Y-10.
     ```
   - A lead-out of 0.01 mm (`G40 G01 X-25. Y-10.01`) also posts with no warning.
   - On this block the control moves the wire centre from the offset path onto the contour point. The kerf then cuts into the part. This is the same hazard that the lead-in rule stops.
   - Fix: give the cancel move the same rule as the engage move in `wireOffsetMove`: finite start and end points, and a length of the offset radius or more. If the owner permits a shorter lead-out, refuse at least a zero length and record the reason in the decision file. Pin the refusal, and pin a lead-out of exactly the radius.

2. **The program tells the operator that no wire offset is used, and then uses one.** Class: notes that are written before the `COMP` record arrives and are false for an offset section.
   - `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:244` writes `(WIRE-CENTRE PATH - NO WIRE OFFSET G41 G42 IS USED)` in each program. The PR body names this line under "Not exercised".
   - `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:375` writes `(SIDE LEFT - KERF IN THE PATH)` when the stream states `WireSide`. The PR does not name this line.
   - `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:147-149` writes `(CONDITION C001 KERF GAP 0.040 MM - COMPARE WITH THE CONTROL ROW)` or `THE KERF USES AN EXAMPLE GAP`. With control compensation the path has no kerf in it.
   - Probe output (machine with a `C001` row, `WireSide left`, one pass with `COMP right 0.165`):
     ```
     (WIRE-CENTRE PATH - NO WIRE OFFSET G41 G42 IS USED)
     ...
     (SIDE LEFT - KERF IN THE PATH)
     (CONDITION C001 KERF GAP 0.040 MM - COMPARE WITH THE CONTROL ROW)
     ...
     (WIRE OFFSET H001 WITH CONDITION C001 - THE PATH IS THE PART CONTOUR, NOT THE WIRE CENTRE - ...)
     G42 H001
     ```
   - The value in `H001` sets the part size. A program that states two opposite things about the offset is not safe to give to an operator.
   - Fix with one rule: the engine tells the script before `onOpen` if the stream has a `COMP` record (as it does with `programTools` and `programBounds`), or the post finds this in a different way before it writes the notes. Then the header line and the section notes are correct for an offset program, and a program without `COMP` stays byte-identical. Pin the header and the section notes of an offset program.

3. **`assets/posts/AGENTS.md:379-380` is now false.** It says that the LN2W post "refuses by name each taper (...), 4-axis and any `COMP` record". Update the paragraph: the offset form, the shared helper, the refusals, the decision record and the pins in `crates/post/tests/sodick_ln2w/offset.rs`.

4. **Two refusals have no pin.** The PR body lists "a change of side while the offset is on is refused" as part of the law, but no test has it (`crates/post/src/post/wire_offset.rs:44-46`). This is also the only stream that reaches the refusal branch of `onRadiusCompensation` (`assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:293-295`): the stream parser refuses a radius that is not positive before the hook runs. Add a pin for `COMP right`, a move, `COMP left`: a refusal that names the operation, and no cut after it. The H001 to H999 limit (`sodick-ln2w.cps:311`) also has no pin; add it if a small stream can reach it, or say in the body that it is not pinned.

5. **The commit type is `fix`, but the change is a new capability.** Issue #4076 has the label `enhancement`. The post refused each `COMP` record by a decision (#1498), and now it writes the control's offset. By "Commits and Releases" this is a `feat`: it gives a MINOR bump and merges at the next cut. Change the PR title to `feat(post): ...`, and correct the issue comment to `merges at the next cut`. Do not force-push to change the commit subject.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:508-511`: `offsetStep` changes the state of the law before `cutOk` runs. If `cutOk` then refuses the lead-in without `sectionOk = false` (the "a move changes Z" refusal at line 476), the `G42` line and the lead-in are not written, but the later moves and `G40 G01` are written. The program has a counted warning, so the app does not release it. A `sectionOk = false` on that path makes the refused text shorter and clearer.
- The offset note is about 175 characters. Does the LN2W control keep a comment of that length? The other notes of this post are shorter.
- A pass that engages the offset after a first plain cut (`G01`, then `G42 H001`, then the lead-in) posts with no warning. This is correct by the stream contract. It is not pinned.
- `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` (412 lines) and `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs` (743 lines) were over 400 lines before this PR. The PR adds one line to each.
- `Fixes #4076` closes the issue while its item 4 (app goldens with the offset on) moves to #4134. The body says so. This is acceptable to me.
- The light lane step `light build (release --no-run)` is red on main for `start_exit_shared` (above). It is not a finding on this PR.

## Labels

I set `needs-rework`. The PR is a draft and stays a draft. The PR merges cleanly with main at this time.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the five findings of the review of `d2e1519ba`. The new head is `430c41c52c06ea1f2ad5dc1adb0c13fdfad29999`. It waits for a fresh review.

1. **Lead-out rule.** `wireOffsetMove` now uses one helper, `_woLead`, for the engage move and for the cancel move. The helper refuses a move with no stated end points, with no length, or shorter than the offset radius. The probe stream (`G40` on a move of zero length) and the 0.01 mm lead-out are refused by name, and no `G40` block is written. The decision file records that the owner stated the rule for the lead-in only.
   - Pin: `offset::a_lead_out_shorter_than_the_wire_radius_is_refused_by_name`. It also pins a lead-out of exactly the radius (`G40 G01 X-25. Y-10.165`).
   - Mutation: the `_woLead` call for the cancel move removed. Red. Restored. Green.
2. **Notes of an offset program.** The engine publishes `programOffsets` before `onOpen`: one entry for each section, `"control"`, `"wear"` or `""`. The post writes the header line, the side note and the condition note from it. An offset program does not say "NO WIRE OFFSET". A section on the control's offset does not say "KERF IN THE PATH" or "COMPARE WITH THE CONTROL ROW". A wear section and a section without `COMP` keep the kerf notes. A program without `COMP` is byte-identical (the LN2W goldens in `wire_post` and the catalog suites are green and not changed).
   - Pin: `offset::the_notes_of_an_offset_program_state_the_offset`.
   - Mutation: `offsetMode` and `offsetProgram` return "no offset". Red. Restored. Green.
3. **`assets/posts/AGENTS.md`.** The LN2W paragraph now states the offset form, the shared helper, each refusal, the decision record and the pins in `offset.rs`. It also lists `programOffsets`. `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md` lists `programOffsets` too.
4. **Two refusals without a pin.**
   - Pin: `offset::a_change_of_side_while_the_offset_is_on_is_refused_by_name` (`COMP right`, a move, `COMP left`: a refusal that names the operation, and no cut after it). Mutation: `if (st.active)` changed to `if (false)`. Red. Restored. Green.
   - Pin: `offset::a_pass_above_h999_is_refused_by_name` (1000 passes: `H999` posts, pass 1000 is refused). Mutation: `pass > 999` changed to `pass > 99999`. Red. Restored. Green.
5. **Commit type.** The PR title is now `feat(post): ...`. The new commit is a `feat` commit. The issue comment on #4076 is corrected to `merges at the next cut`. I did not force-push.

Gates on `430c41c52` against `upstream/main` dc3679fb5:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 212 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 72 steps, 0 failed.
- Goldens moved: none.

The non-blocking notes of the review are not changed. The PR body lists them under "Not exercised". The PR is still a draft. Please review the new head.

Reviewer: m3 pool job claude-team2 (the environment states no job kind or number), Claude Opus 5.5, mkinney / seat claude-team2; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge (at the next cut, because this is a `feat`).** This is a SAFETY-tier re-review: the PR changes posted G-code. It reviews the new head `430c41c52` after the review of `d2e1519ba`.

## Earlier findings (review of `d2e1519ba`)

1. **Lead-out rule. Fixed.** `wireOffsetMove` calls `_woLead` for the cancel move too (`crates/post/src/post/wire_offset.rs:128-129`). A lead-out with no length or shorter than the radius is refused by name, and no `G40` block is written. Pin: `offset::a_lead_out_shorter_than_the_wire_radius_is_refused_by_name`. It covers no length, 0.01 mm, and exactly the radius (posts `G40 G01 X-25. Y-10.165`). I ran the mutation again (see below).
2. **False notes in an offset program. Fixed.** The engine publishes `programOffsets` before `onOpen` (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:161`, `wire_offset::sections`). The header, the side note and the condition note read it (`assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:151-155, 265-266, 397-400`). I checked these points:
   - `sections` reads the same `records` that the engine loop walks. No transform comes after line 161.
   - `sectionNo++` in `onSectionEnd` runs on each path, because `refuse` does not throw. So the index stays in step with the `SECTION` end records.
   - A program without `COMP` keeps the old lines. `wire_post` and the three `example_catalog*` suites are green, and no golden moved.
   Pin: `offset::the_notes_of_an_offset_program_state_the_offset`. I ran a mutation again (see below).
3. **`assets/posts/AGENTS.md`. Fixed.** The LN2W paragraph states the offset form, the helper, each refusal, `programOffsets`, the decision record and `offset.rs`. The globals list has `programOffsets`.
4. **Two refusals without a pin. Fixed.** `offset::a_change_of_side_while_the_offset_is_on_is_refused_by_name` and `offset::a_pass_above_h999_is_refused_by_name` are new, and both pass.
5. **Commit type. Fixed.** The PR title is `feat(post): ...`, and the new commit is a `feat` commit. The first commit keeps its `fix` subject (no force-push). The merge commit takes the PR title, so the cut sees a `feat`.

## Results, merged with `upstream/main` 12ea01a45 (built locally on m3, no runner)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `upstream/main` | clean (HEAD^1 = `430c41c52`) |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 212 steps, 0 failed. This includes `script_sodick_ln2w`, `script_sodick_wire`, `sodick_*`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` and `wire_post` |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_sodick_ln2w` | 25 passed, 0 failed (10 `offset::` pins) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed. The `start_exit_shared` build failure of the last review is gone on this main |
| Heavy lanes | not run. They are not a merge condition (#3556). The author's run (72 steps, 0 failed, against `dc3679fb5`) is in the PR body |

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

Goldens moved: none. `git diff --stat upstream/main...430c41c52 -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog` is empty.

## Mutations that I ran again

| Mutation | Pin | Mutated | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wire_offset.rs`: the `_woLead` call for the cancel move removed | `offset::a_lead_out_shorter_than_the_wire_radius_is_refused_by_name` | red | green |
| `wire_offset.rs` `sections`: a control `COMP` record does not set `"control"` | `offset::the_notes_of_an_offset_program_state_the_offset` | red | green |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The three notes of the earlier review (a `sectionOk = false` on the "a move changes Z" refusal, the length of the offset note, a pin for an offset that engages after a plain cut) are still open. The PR body says so. They do not block.
- A section that has a control pass and a wear pass gets the "control" section notes. The PR body says that this mix is not pinned.

## Labels

I set `merge-ready` and removed `needs-rework`. The `needs-rework` label came from the earlier review on `d2e1519ba`. No NeoTech review or label asks for changes on this head. The PR merges cleanly with main. It is a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
